hook: Four-tile intro; model creation then calculated squat group-contour transition. No process explanation text.
intro_contour_source: Saved squat group force at the same phase as the lower-left action, on the neutral display pose; not a new standing-load solve.
frame_sampling: Exact 121-frame normal and 181-frame slow display-cycle sampling; no moving-pose cross-fades.
force_semantics: Scalar muscle-tendon tension; group bilateral sum / 2; not activation.

tension_exposure.metric: Integral of scalar muscle tension over one active movement
tension_exposure.windows: Jump preparation to settled landing; squat descent start to ascent end
tension_exposure.display: Per-side muscle-group integral, logarithmic colour scale; integrals unchanged.
